<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Update a tracing account</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"put"} path={"/v1/account-management/consumption/tracing-accounts/{id}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Updates a tracing account of a **Consumption** owner account.

This replaces the account's settings, so send every field - including `maxDailyGB`, which is the account's soft limit.
Available for **Consumption** accounts only, and only once the Consumption tracing accounts API is enabled for your account. Otherwise the request returns `400`.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
